items.title: Senior Manager, Fraud Strategy & Operations
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team The Fraud and Risk Operations team safeguards Raisin’s U.S. business by monitoring, detecting, and mitigating risks across the customer lifecycle. We manage fraud prevention, investigations, payments risk, fraud recovery, and while supporting 2nd line AML/KYC oversight. It partners closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Customer Service to ensure safe and frictionless customer experiences. As a multi-bank deposit marketplace targeting rapid growth, Raisin faces complex, evolving multi-vector fraud challenges across onboarding, identity verification, bank linking, and money movement. Fraud and Risk Operations is at the center of designing the strategies, controls, and analytical foundations that protect the platform at scale. Your Responsibilities This role directly reports to the Head of Fraud Operations and is a senior expert role at Raisin US. We are looking for a Fraud Operations Specialist to assist in the design, building, and optimizing our fraud prevention and detection framework. In this role, you will be responsible for creating both predictive (pre-transaction/real-time mitigation) and detective (post-transaction/monitoring) rules within our risk platform. You will analyze emerging fraud patterns, balance fraud mitigation with user friction, and collaborate with product, engineering, payments, service and other allied teams to protect the Raisin platform and its customers while optimizing transaction approval rates. Predictive & Preventative Strategy (Real-Time Rules) Real-Time Rule Authoring: Design, test, and deploy real-time logic within the risk rules engine (e.g., velocity checks, device fingerprinting triggers, IP risk thresholds, and behavioral anomalies, etc.) to intercept fraudulent actions during the entire customer lifecycle. Risk Model Integration: Partner with internal and external platform partners to integrate, build and implement both customer and transaction level fraud scores into the rules engine, creating conditional logic that automatically approves, blocks, or challenges high-risk events. Friction Optimization: Monitor and optimize false positive rates to ensure legitimate customer transactions pass through with minimal friction. Detective & Post-Transaction Strategy (Monitoring & Analysis) Behavioral & Batch Monitoring: Build detective monitoring rules, threshold alerts, and transaction reports to identify complex fraud patterns, first party fraud triggers, account takeover, synthetic ID, or coordinated fraud rings after events occur. Chargeback & Loss Root-Cause Analysis: Conduct post-mortems on confirmed fraud instances and Reg E disputes to identify gaps in existing rule sets and rapidly deploy backtest-verified countermeasures. Rule Performance Tuning: Regularly review, backtest, and refine active rules to eliminate stale logic, reduce redundancy, and adapt to shifting fraud tactics. Utilize the iterations of rules to also actively monitor the existing customer book. Rules and telemetry expansion: Active work internally and externally to seek additional risk signals, and proactively deploy to stay ahead of emerging fraud patterns. Fraud Strategy & Operations Responsible for partnering with the Head of Fraud to own and execute Raisin’s U.S. fraud strategy across onboarding, account linking, and payment flows. Design and refine fraud policies, rules, controls, and escalation processes. Lead fraud investigations end-to-end and translate findings into durable controls. Build fraud KPIs, dashboards, and performance reporting for leadership. Quantify fraud exposure, loss trends, and efficiency metrics to inform strategic decisions. Fraud Modeling & Advanced Analytics Own the roadmap for fraud models across the customer lifecycle. Build and maintain customer risk profiling and scoring frameworks and enhance monitoring of high-risk customers. Design, implement, and deploy machine learning models for anomaly detection, identity risk, behavioral analytics, and transaction monitoring. Build features from device, behavioral, graph, identity, ACH/payment telemetry, and network data. Partner with Engineering and Data to ensure high-quality data pipelines for real-time model scoring. Translate model outputs into practical decision strategies (rules, thresholds, step-up flows). Your Profile 8+ years in fraud risk management, fraud analytics, fraud data science, AML/financial crime, or payments risk (fintech, digital banking, payments a strong plus). Strong technical skills: Python, SQL, and experience with feature engineering, model development, and fraud analytics. Proven ability to design, deploy, and monitor machine learning models in production. Deep familiarity with U.S. fraud typologies: identity fraud, mule activity, ATO, synthetic IDs, ACH fraud, bank linking fraud, and payment abuse. Understanding of AML/KYC frameworks and how they intersect with fraud controls. Experience influencing decisions across Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations. Excellent communication skills with the ability to present insights to executive leadership. Strategic, analytical mindset with a focus on balancing fraud prevention, operations scalability, and customer experience. Leadership experience, formal or informal, and ability to scale influence across teams. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Flexible working hours and up to 28 days PTO accrued from your first month, plus 13 public holidays. Employee Development Budget of $2,200 and 4 full training days per year. Company 401k contribution of 5%. Healthcare coverage contribution, including medical, dental and vision. Commuter benefits and flexible working from home policy. Regular team events and yearly Summer and Winter Party. Salary Range $90,000 — $130,000 USD Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

items.title: Design Engineer
items.location_text: United States, San Francisco, Canada, New York, Toronto
items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a design engineer to help build and maintain Waypoint, our design system, across both the Figma library and the production codebase. This is not a "designer who codes a little" or an "engineer who dabbles in Figma" role. You should be genuinely fluent on both sides, comfortable defining a component's behavior and states in Figma one hour and shipping the same component to npm the next. You'll take direct ownership of the Figma side of our library (structure, variants, tokens, documentation) while also contributing to the core Waypoint system: our component packages, our token pipeline, and the tooling that keeps design and code in sync. If the idea of being the single point of continuity between a Figma frame and a production component sounds exciting rather than exhausting, this is your role. We're also thinking beyond the system we have today. Waypoint isn't just meant to serve designers and engineers, it's meant to become something a model can read, reason about, and build with directly. We want someone who can help us get there: grounded enough to do the unglamorous work of making today's system solid, and forward looking enough to help define what an intelligent design system looks like next. WHY THIS ROLE Waypoint is still early enough that the decisions you make now will shape how the system scales. You'll have real ownership, not just a queue of component tickets, and you'll be working alongside a team that treats design and engineering as one discipline rather than two departments that hand work back and forth. And you'll be helping define what a design system becomes when it has to serve a third audience: the models that will increasingly build with it. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own and evolve the Figma library for Waypoint: component structure, variants, properties, and documentation, so it stays a reliable source of truth for design teams. - Build and maintain core Waypoint components, contributing directly to our component packages alongside the design engineering team. - Work across our token pipeline, keeping design tokens in Figma and their code representations (CSS custom properties, Tailwind config) tightly synced. - Partner with product designers to translate new patterns into system components, and with product engineers to make sure those components are easy to adopt correctly. - Help define and refine the workflows and tooling that connect Figma and code (sync scripts, plugins, documentation sites) rather than relying on manual handoff. - Write clear documentation and usage guidance so the system scales without you being the bottleneck. - Weigh in on system architecture decisions: when to add a new component versus extend an existing one, how to version and package changes, how to keep the system consistent as it grows. - Help shape how Waypoint evolves to serve a third consumer beyond designers and engineers: the model itself. That means thinking about how components, tokens, and patterns get structured so they're legible to AI systems, not just to humans. QUALIFICATIONS - Own and evolve the Figma library for Waypoint: component structure, variants, properties, and documentation, so it stays a reliable source of truth for design teams. - Build and maintain core Waypoint components, contributing directly to our component packages alongside the design engineering team. - Work across our token pipeline, keeping design tokens in Figma and their code representations (CSS custom properties, Tailwind config) tightly synced. - Partner with product designers to translate new patterns into system components, and with product engineers to make sure those components are easy to adopt correctly. - Help define and refine the workflows and tooling that connect Figma and code (sync scripts, plugins, documentation sites) rather than relying on manual handoff. - Write clear documentation and usage guidance so the system scales without you being the bottleneck. - Weigh in on system architecture decisions: when to add a new component versus extend an existing one, how to version and package changes, how to keep the system consistent as it grows. - Help shape how Waypoint evolves to serve a third consumer beyond designers and engineers: the model itself. That means thinking about how components, tokens, and patterns get structured so they're legible to AI systems, not just to humans. NICE-TO-HAVES - Experience building or contributing to design-to-code sync tooling (Figma plugins, token pipelines, MCP-based workflows, or similar). - Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and how to bake them into components rather than bolt them on. - Experience packaging and versioning component libraries for multiple consuming teams (npm scoped packages, semver, changelogs). - Exposure to multi-platform design systems work (iOS/SwiftUI, Android/Jetpack Compose, or token build tools like Style Dictionary). - Experience in an AI native product environment or genuine interest in how AI changes the way design systems get built and used. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role Studio is where creators build and finish video on ElevenLabs, powered by our generative graph engine, Flows. You’ll own our “produce once, distribute everywhere” workflow. It takes a finished Studio project and runs it through our dubbing pipeline to produce it in many languages and aspect ratios, with auto-translated captions. Today that means duplicating and rebuilding projects by hand. This work is entirely greenfield: the specs aren’t written yet. You’ll shape them through written proposals (RFCs), pressure-test data structures with the team lead, and carry the project from first draft to launch. You’re a strong backend generalist who is good with complex data structures and has the product instincts to decide what’s worth building. Requirements - Strong backend generalist who has designed and shipped complex, data-heavy systems end to end. - Comfortable with enterprise-grade concerns such as usage reporting and accounts. - Evidence of product ownership: side projects, open source, or work in a product-facing context. - Has taken projects from inception to launch with little hand-holding. Bonus: experience with media or video-processing pipelines (helpful, not required) We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

This is a full-cycle individual-contributor role for a strong recruiter who can run an excellent process end to end—sourcing, screening, managing stakeholders, and closing. You’ll partner with hiring managers across EMEA to understand what great looks like, build healthy pipelines, and deliver a candidate experience that reflects Anthropic’s values. You’ll work in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift, and you’ll have real ownership over the roles you run. We’re open to candidates whose strength is in G&A recruiting or in GTM recruiting; in your application, tell us where your experience is deepest. Key responsibilities Own full-cycle recruiting for a portfolio of G&A or GTM roles across EMEA—from intake through offer and close Partner with hiring managers to scope roles, calibrate the bar, and build effective sourcing strategies Source and engage high-quality active and passive candidates, building diverse and competitive pipelines Run structured, rigorous, and candidate-centric interview processes that uphold Anthropic’s hiring bar Manage candidates through the process with clear communication and a great experience at every stage Collaborate with the broader Talent team, People Partners, and Compensation to structure offers and guide candidates to close Use data to track pipeline health and share insight that helps hiring managers make good decisions Minimum qualifications Track record of closing strong candidates in competitive markets Familiarity with the EMEA talent landscape and comfort recruiting across multiple countries Strong stakeholder management—you build trust and partnership with hiring managers Excellent organization and the ability to manage multiple searches at once without dropping details Clear, direct communication style and a bias toward action Comfort operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment Genuine interest in Anthropic’s mission and the role recruiting plays in achieving it Preferred qualifications 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in either G&A (Finance, Legal, People) or GTM (Sales, Marketing, Partnerships) hiring Experience recruiting at a high-growth technology, AI, or machine learning company Experience recruiting across both G&A and GTM functions Experience hiring across multiple EMEA markets, including the UK and Ireland Familiarity with Greenhouse or similar ATS platforms Additional European language skills relevant to hiring across the region The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Value Strategist
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role ElevenLabs is looking for a Value Strategist to help our customers identify, quantify, and realize the business value of ElevenLabs across our portfolio, with a primary focus on ElevenAgents. This is a senior individual contributor role within our global Revenue organization, spanning the full customer lifecycle from early sales conversations through proof of concept, deployment, renewal, and expansion. You will work directly with customers and prospects to understand their businesses, build the case for investment, and establish how that value will be measured over time. On our most strategic accounts, Deployment Strategists in our Forward Deployed Engineering team already build account-specific business cases and ROI narratives as part of delivery. You will partner with them rather than duplicate that work. Your mandate is the value discipline across the whole book: the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial accounts where no one is embedded, and where value today is quantified deal by deal or not at all. You will build the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, and playbooks that let every seller articulate and measure value consistently, and you will use what you learn from strategic deployments to make that methodology sharper. This is not a quota-carrying role, nor is it a traditional advisory function. We are looking for a builder and a doer: someone who can engage credibly with senior customer stakeholders, get deep into a customer's operations and data, build rigorous models themselves, and turn ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable recommendations. You will define how ElevenLabs understands, measures, and communicates customer value globally. In this role you will - Shape value from the beginning. Partner with Revenue teams and prospects early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify high-value opportunities, and establish the business case for investing in ElevenLabs. - Build our global value strategy. Develop the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, discovery approaches, and playbooks that define how ElevenLabs approaches value across industries and use cases. - Scale what works. Turn bespoke work with our largest customers into repeatable approaches that enable our Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial teams to articulate and measure value without requiring bespoke support for every customer. - Identify where ElevenLabs can have the greatest impact. Develop a deep understanding of a customer's business, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities to determine which use cases have the greatest potential and why. - Quantify the opportunity. Build rigorous financial and operational models that translate ElevenLabs use cases into measurable outcomes across revenue, cost, productivity, customer experience, and other relevant dimensions. - Define how value will be proven. Establish success metrics and measurement approaches for proofs of concept and deployments so that customers and ElevenLabs have a shared understanding of what success looks like from the outset. - Measure value realization. Partner with customers and internal teams after deployment to understand the impact ElevenLabs is delivering, identify gaps between expected and realized value, and determine where additional opportunities exist. - Support expansion and long-term customer value. Use insights from existing deployments to help customers understand what they have achieved and identify where ElevenLabs can drive additional impact. - Work directly with the data. Analyze customer and industry data, build models, pressure-test assumptions, and develop recommendations yourself. You should be equally comfortable working in the details and communicating the implications. - Partner with Deployment. On strategic accounts, work alongside Deployment Strategists who own the account-level business case, contributing methodology and capturing what works into reusable assets. Across the rest of the book, be the primary owner of value quantification and measurement. - Influence senior stakeholders. Communicate complex analysis simply and credibly, and engage with senior leaders internally and externally when the opportunity requires it. Requirements - 10+ years of relevant experience across operating roles, strategy, management consulting, analytics, finance, customer strategy, or other roles requiring rigorous business problem solving. - Strong operating judgment. You understand how businesses work and can quickly get underneath a customer's operating model, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities. - Exceptional analytical ability. You can personally build sophisticated financial and operational models, work with incomplete or imperfect information, make assumptions explicit, and turn analysis into decisions. - Structured problem solving. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous question such as "Where could AI create the most value in this business?" and developing a rigorous approach to answering it. - Customer credibility. You can work directly with customers across functions and levels, ask incisive questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and establish trust quickly. - Commercial judgment. You understand how business value connects to technology investment decisions and can partner closely with Revenue teams while maintaining an objective, customer-first perspective. - Excellent communication. You can distill complex analysis into a clear point of view and communicate it effectively in writing and verbally, from working teams through senior executives. - A builder mentality. You are excited to start by doing the work yourself, learn from customers, and turn what works into scalable methodologies and tools. - Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You can move quickly across industries, customer types, and use cases while maintaining a high bar for analytical rigor. - Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable partnering with teams and customers across regions and traveling when valuable for customer work. - Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time. Bonus points - Experience in strategy or management consulting, particularly in operational transformation, technology, customer experience, or growth. - Experience as an operator within a technology company or other fast-moving business. - Experience working on AI, automation, customer experience, or technology-enabled business transformation. - Experience developing business cases, value frameworks, or analytical methodologies that were ultimately scaled beyond an individual project or customer. - Experience working with enterprise customers on complex, cross-functional initiatives. Location This is a global role within the Revenue organization. The role can be based in San Francisco or remotely, with the option to work from our San Francisco office. You will work with customers and ElevenLabs teams across regions and should expect travel for customer meetings and onsite work when it meaningfully advances the work. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

This role is deliberately separate from invoice processing and payments. You will control vendor records and bank details; you will not book invoices or move money. That separation is the point of the role, and you will own the SOX controls that enforce it and help design the access model that keeps it that way. This is an opportunity to build a vendor-master function from the ground up and leverage process automation with Claude while supporting the team making AI safe. reporting Bank details and fraud prevention Own every bank-detail setup and change; validate against a bank letter on letterhead or an approved equivalent (void checks, etc.) Run independent callbacks reviewed changes Run periodic health reviews for dormant vendors, stale bank letters, missing tax forms and incomplete records; drive 1099 and TIN readiness for year-end Own periodic vendor deactivation campaigns Controls and audit Own the vendor-master SOX controls as the named control owner: maker-checker on every create and change, change-log review, evidence retained on every record Prepare the periodic review of bank-detail changes paid, and address Internal Audit and external auditor requests Partner with Finance Systems to design and maintain ERP security roles so vendor master, invoicing and payments stay separated Flag any suspicious vendor set-up activity through the appropriate channels Process, systems and improvement Own vendor-master documentation, intake checklists, requester guidance and service levels Serve as the vendor-data expert through process migrations, including data conversion and post-migration fixes Partner on automation: AI-assisted intake validation, document extraction, bank-format checks and a vendor self-service portal Report monthly on onboarding volume, cycle time, bank changes, exceptions and data quality, and use the data to improve the process Minimum qualifications 7+ years in vendor master or AP operations with 3+ years of ownership Owned a vendor master in an ERP end to end — process, controls and data — across vendor tax documentation: W-9/W-8 validation, TIN matching, VAT/GST IDs, 1099 flagging Working knowledge of procure-to-pay controls — segregation of duties, maker-checker, change logs, audit evidence Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME We are looking for curious and rigorous minds to push the boundaries of Generative AI at Betclic. Our GenAI Center of Excellence builds and runs generative-AI applications for the whole group. Among them is a semantic-analysis platform that turns millions of raw texts (customer conversations, support tickets, news) into clear, actionable themes for several business teams. The method behind it is the one the AI labs use on their own data. Anthropic’s Clio makes sense of millions of conversations with Claude without anyone reading them; GitHub and Google Research have published the same recipe: embed the texts, cluster them, let an LLM name what emerges. Each runs it on its own data; almost nobody applies it to everyday business text. We do. You will join the GenAI Center of Excellence in Bordeaux, working with GenAI solution architects and will be exposed to business teams expressing analysis needs. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC As a GenAI Research Intern at Betclic, you will work on a question this field has not answered yet. Today, these systems group texts by what they are about. Grouping them by an angle you choose (tone of voice, urgency, intent) means paying an LLM to rewrite every document first. Can the representation itself be oriented, so that steering costs almost nothing? And before that: how do you prove that one clustering is better than another? Your missions will include: Mapping the state of the art in LLM-assisted clustering, steerable embeddings and clustering evaluation. Designing an evaluation protocol (reference corpora, metrics, LLM-as-a-judge) and measuring how far it can be trusted. Running controlled experiments that compare clustering pipelines, embedding models and orientation techniques, on real corpora as well as public benchmarks. Writing up your protocols and conclusions as research notes, and presenting them to the team and to business stakeholders. This internship will give you hands-on experience of the methods the AI labs use on their own data, and a research question you own end to end, from hypothesis to conclusion. This internship is for you if you: Are currently enrolled in a Master’s degree (or equivalent, final year) in Machine Learning, Data Science, NLP, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. Have strong analytical skills and scientific rigour, are autonomous, and care more about why something works than about making it work once. Are proficient in Python and at ease building with LLMs and agents : LLM APIs, prompting, tool calling, and AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow. Want to grow your skills in communicating experimental results clearly, including what they do not prove. Work comfortably in English or French. Nice to have : Previous exposure to embeddings, clustering or topic modelling (e.g. sentence-transformers, UMAP, HDBSCAN, BERTopic), or to LLM APIs. A first research experience: a lab internship, a paper, or a habit of reproducible experiments. An interest in sports or gaming industries is appreciated, but not required. items.title: Software Engineer, HSM Infrastructure Security, Consumer Devices
items.description: We are hiring a Security Software Engineer to design and implement the hardware-backed security foundations used across OpenAI’s device ecosystem. A central focus of this role is hardening the boundary between our policy systems and the HSMs that protect sensitive cryptographic keys. This boundary determines which operations may be performed, what may be signed, which policies must be satisfied, and how changes to trusted software and policy are authorized. You will develop security-critical software and firmware within, or immediately adjacent to, an HSM trust boundary. Depending on your background, this may include HSM trusted applications, firmware services, cryptographic mechanisms, device drivers, PKCS#11 components, secure-provisioning protocols, or signing-policy enforcement systems. This is a hands-on software-engineering role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review production code, debug across hardware and software boundaries, and carry projects from initial requirements through deployment. It is not an HSM administration, PKI operations, compliance, or architecture-only position. In This Role, You Will - Design and implement security-critical software and firmware for HSMs, secure elements, trusted execution environments, and hardware roots of trust. - Build and harden the policy-to-HSM boundary responsible for authorizing certificate issuance and cryptographic signing operations. - Develop HSM trusted applications, firmware components, host interfaces, device drivers, SDKs, or cryptographic service integrations. - Implement or extend cryptographic interfaces such as PKCS#11, OpenSSL providers or engines, platform key-storage APIs, or comparable hardware-security interfaces. - Build firmware and software that cryptographically enforces key generation, provisioning, usage, rotation, recovery, and destruction policies. - Design and implement HSM-backed certificate authority, code-signing, key-management, and device-identity systems. - Develop end-to-end cryptographic protocols spanning devices, secure hardware, policy services, and backend infrastructure. - Build security capabilities supporting device attestation, secure boot, factory provisioning and restoration, user registration, and authentication. - Design controls that make trusted software and policy changes verifiable, auditable, and subject to appropriate multi-party authorization. - Write, review, test, and audit secure embedded software for resource-constrained environments. - Develop test harnesses, emulators, fuzzers, and fault-injection tooling to validate security properties and failure behavior. - Threat-model hardware and software trust boundaries and translate findings into concrete engineering improvements. - Partner with hardware, firmware, infrastructure, application, and security teams to integrate secure-by-default capabilities into production systems. - Help establish engineering standards for HSM development, applied cryptography, secure key management, and certificate infrastructure. Minimum Qualifications - 5+ years experience building secure embedded firmware for constrained environments - Deep programming experience in C, C++, or Rust. You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have - A strong track record of designing, implementing, debugging, and shipping production systems software. - Hands-on experience developing security-critical software or firmware within, or directly adjacent to, an HSM, secure element, TEE, or hardware root of trust. - Experience developing one or more of the following: - HSM firmware or trusted applications - Cryptographic mechanisms or hardware-accelerated cryptographic services - HSM device drivers, host libraries, SDKs, or middleware - PKCS#11 providers, mechanisms, or integrations - Secure key-provisioning or key-injection protocols - HSM-backed certificate authority or code-signing systems - Signing-policy enforcement within a hardware-backed trust boundary - Strong knowledge of applied cryptography, digital signatures, key hierarchies, secure key management, and cryptographic protocol design. - Experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, certificate authorities, certificate issuance, and certificate lifecycle protocols. - Familiarity with secure boot, measured boot, device identity, remote attestation, or hardware-backed storage. - Experience reasoning about concurrency, memory safety, privilege separation, hardware interfaces, failure modes, and side-channel or physical attack considerations. - The ability to evaluate security designs and personally implement the software required to realize them. - Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate across hardware, firmware, backend, and product teams. Additional Experience That May Be Helpful - Firmware development for ARM TrustZone or another trusted execution environment. - Experience with commercial or cloud HSM platforms such as Thales Luna, Entrust/nShield, Utimaco, Marvell LiquidSecurity, AWS CloudHSM, or comparable systems. - Experience with PKCS#11, KMIP, OpenSSL providers or engines, secure-element APIs, or platform-native key-storage frameworks. - Device manufacturing, secure provisioning, factory restore, or silicon bring-up experience. - Secure boot ROM, bootloader, firmware-signing, anti-rollback, or authenticated-update development. - Developing trusted applications or cryptographic services inside an HSM or secure coprocessor. - Hardware/software co-design involving cryptographic accelerators, secure processors, or custom silicon. - Multi-party authorization, quorum-controlled deployments, tamper-resistant audit mechanisms, or attestable policy systems. - Secure or private storage systems based on hardware-protected keys. - Experience sustaining high-assurance security software in production. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. Bonus: - Familiarity with dbt or modern data transformation tooling. - Experience with BI tools such as Sigma or Looker. items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced Privacy Program Manager to join our Legal Team and help build and scale ElevenLabs’ global privacy program. In this role, you will translate privacy requirements into effective, repeatable processes across the company and drive the day-to-day operation of key privacy initiatives. You will work closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, Safety, and GTM teams to operationalize privacy-by-design, manage privacy assessments and compliance workflows, and strengthen the systems and processes that support ElevenLabs’ growing global business. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep privacy program experience with strong project management skills and enjoys building scalable programs in a fast-moving AI environment. RESPONSIBILITIES - Manage and continuously improve ElevenLabs’ global privacy program, translating legal and regulatory requirements into scalable operational processes and controls. - Own and coordinate privacy compliance workflows across frameworks including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, HIPAA, and applicable biometric privacy requirements. - Manage privacy impact assessment processes, including Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), and assessments involving AI systems, biometric data, voice technologies, health information, and other sensitive data. - Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Security teams to operationalize privacy-by-design throughout the product development lifecycle. - Maintain data inventories, records of processing activities (RoPAs), data flow documentation, and other privacy governance records. - Manage processes for data subject and consumer rights requests, including access, deletion, correction, and opt-out requests, and help ensure requests are handled consistently and within applicable deadlines. - Partner with Security and Legal on third-party and vendor privacy assessments, data processing requirements, and privacy-related risk remediation. - Support privacy incident response and regulatory or customer inquiries by coordinating documentation, stakeholders, timelines, and follow-up actions. - Implement and administer privacy tooling and automation to improve the efficiency and scalability of privacy operations including maintaining ElevenLabs’ consent management platform and partnering with Legal, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to ensure cookie, tracking technology, and other consent and preference mechanisms are appropriately configured, documented, monitored, and updated as our products and regulatory requirements evolve. - Develop privacy program metrics, dashboards, and reporting to track compliance, identify risks, and communicate program maturity and priorities to stakeholders. - Develop and maintain privacy policies, procedures, playbooks, templates, and internal guidance. - Coordinate privacy training and awareness initiatives across the company. WHO YOU ARE - Excited by AI and emerging technologies and interested in solving novel privacy challenges involving voice, biometrics, health information, and other sensitive data. - An exceptional program manager who can turn complex requirements into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes. - Comfortable operating across Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, and commercial teams and able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Highly organized and detail-oriented, while able to prioritize effectively and maintain momentum across multiple workstreams. - Pragmatic and solutions-oriented, with a strong instinct for building processes that manage risk without creating unnecessary friction. - Comfortable building programs and processes from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. WHAT YOU BRING - 6+ years of experience in privacy program management, privacy operations, data governance, compliance, or a related field, ideally within a technology, SaaS, or AI company. - Demonstrated experience operationalizing privacy requirements under frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other US state privacy laws as well as sector specific frameworks such as HIPAA and biometric privacy requirements. - Technical mindset, you can read a data flow diagram, understand system architectures and keys to data handling and can translate between legal requirements and engineering implementation. - Experience building or significantly improving privacy review processes, privacy impact assessments, or privacy control frameworks. - Hands-on experience managing consent management platforms and cookie/tracking technology compliance, including consent configuration, preference management, and coordination with technical and marketing teams. - Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar. - Privacy certifications such as CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT are a plus. - Excellent project management, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed in the United States. We have a strong preference for the Eastern time zone, ideally New York. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Strategic Delivery Lead, Federal Civilian & State and Local Government
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The OpenAI for Government team brings frontier AI to public institutions to help them achieve their missions. We partner with government leaders, mission owners, and technical teams to deploy AI tools responsibly, with the reliability, security, and support needed for meaningful use. Our Federal Civilian and State & Local Government business supports public institutions across a broad range of missions. We help these customers apply frontier AI to public services, knowledge work, research, and mission operations through hands-on delivery, tailored enablement, and collaboration with their teams. ABOUT THE ROLE The Strategic Delivery Lead (SDL), Federal Civilian & State and Local Government, will shape and deliver high-impact AI engagements across federal civilian agencies and state and local governments. You will turn customer priorities into practical deployments and sustained use, helping government leaders and mission teams apply OpenAI technology to public services, knowledge discovery, and operational workflows. This individual contributor role reports to the leader of Federal Civilian and State & Local Government. You will work alongside Account Directors and Applied AI Architects across assigned engagements, coordinating Research, Product, Engineering, Policy, Security, and Enablement resources. Account Directors own commercial strategy, contracts, and quota; you own delivery coordination, adoption, and customer outcomes, without an individual sales quota. You will lead execution across customer and OpenAI workstreams: define scope, milestones, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and success measures; surface risks; resolve blockers; and communicate progress to agency executives, program leaders, and working teams. You are accountable for agreed delivery commitments and customer acceptance. Engineering and Product teams remain responsible for technical implementation and operation of the systems they own. This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role combining senior relationship leadership with hands-on execution. Success requires sound judgment, technical fluency, strong program management, and the ability to turn executive alignment into useful technology in government teams’ hands. This role is based in Washington, DC, with domestic travel for high-value customer engagements, workshops, and delivery milestones. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Build trusted relationships with senior government leaders, program owners, and technical and mission teams to identify priorities and turn senior alignment into actionable engagements. - Own delivery plans for assigned federal civilian and state and local government engagements, with clear milestones, accountable owners, customer acceptance criteria, and measurable mission or operational outcomes. - Translate customer and mission needs into requirements and decisions that engineers, domain experts, and senior leaders can act on; communicate progress, limitations, risks, and dependencies clearly. - Connect customer mission and technical teams with OpenAI Research, Product, and Engineering teams to assess promising applications and move feasible opportunities into scoped, supported projects. - Coordinate the Applied AI Architect, specialist engineers, and customer technical teams on architecture, data access, evaluation, integration, and deployment requirements. - Build sustained adoption through practical enablement, user feedback, workflow support, and repeatable playbooks that can be applied across agencies and government customers. - Lead executive reviews and focused workshops in Washington and at customer sites, bringing the right decision-makers and technical experts together to resolve issues and advance delivery. - Identify security, data, infrastructure, contractual, and resourcing risks early; work with the accountable teams to resolve them and escalate decisions promptly. - Prioritize across a small, matrixed team, make clear trade-offs, and maintain momentum as customer needs and model capabilities evolve. - Coordinate with Account Directors, policy colleagues, and partners on broader government engagement, while keeping delivery commitments aligned with available resources and approved capabilities. YOU’LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have 10+ years of experience leading complex technical programs, customer delivery, or transformation initiatives, including substantial work with federal civilian agencies, state or local governments, or comparable public institutions. - Can meet customer-specific access requirements. use Washington-based engagement and remote collaboration effectively. - Understand how government executives, program owners, acquisition stakeholders, and technical teams make decisions and deliver work; navigate organizational boundaries to turn priorities into execution. - Have led complex AI/ML, enterprise software, API, cloud, scientific computing, or digital transformation engagements through implementation and sustained adoption. - Bring executive presence and a record of influencing senior government leaders, while remaining personally accountable for follow-through with working teams. - Translate mission goals into practical execution plans, acceptance criteria, and measures such as workflow adoption, staff productivity, output quality, and time to a validated outcome. - Have enough technical fluency to evaluate AI use cases, challenge assumptions, and work credibly with architects and domain experts on data integration, model evaluation, and deployment trade-offs. - Are curious about frontier AI and actively experiment with the technology to understand its capabilities, limitations, and applications to government work. - Build durable partnerships across mission teams, engineers, security teams, program owners, and executives; thrive in ambiguity and take initiative in a fast-moving environment. - See yourself as a bridge between frontier AI research and practical mission impact, with the judgment to distinguish a promising demonstration from a validated outcome. - Help customers use AI responsibly, with appropriate data protection, human review, provenance, reproducibility, and validation suited to the mission and use case. - Existing relationships across federal civilian agencies or state and local governments are valuable. Experience with DOE, national labs, NASA, or NSF is one relevant area of expertise. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. Highlighting key interdependencies and risks between pods and maintaining a live risk and dependency register (centralized RAID log). Contributing to the EMF process by ensuring team estimations are up to date, supporting the management of group level initiatives. Developing strong working relationships with dependent EveryMatrix Business Units, particularly EM3, to keep cross-BU dependencies visible and on track. Attending cross-pod ceremonies where required to support Product Managers— dependency planning, joint demos, and retrospectives on ways of working. Tracking delivery milestones against the roadmap, flagging slippery and coordinating recovery plans with the relevant Pod Leads. Supporting resourcing and capacity conversations across pods, working with the Head of Product, Head of Delivery and pod leaders to resolve competing priorities. Contributing to RFP responses and enterprise/client conversations, gathering and collating input across pods into a single, coherent narrative. Work with pod leaders to ensure early escalation for cross-pod blockers and dependencies to the Head of Product and Head of Delivery. Support continuous improvement of Client onboarding process & activities through retrospectives to improve onboarding KPI’s. What we’re looking for: Experience of Agile working across multiple pods. Track record delivering complex projects – Preferred background in iGaming, sports betting, or casino platforms (PAM, Payments, Sportsbook, Casino). Program management skills — managing multiple work items, RAID/risk registers and cross-pod tickets concurrently. Practical experience with agile and delivery tooling (e.g. Jira, Confluence or equivalent) for backlog, dependency and risk tracking. Data literate — able to interpret delivery metrics (velocity, throughput, cycle time) and turn them into a clear risk or opportunity narrative. Hands-on experience with AI-assisted delivery workflows in a production context. Highly organized, with strong attention to detail and a bias for keeping information current and trustworthy. Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to flex between technical detail and business/commercial framing depending on audience. Stakeholder management across both internal functions (Growth Services, Account Management, other Business Units) and external clients/operators. Ability to translate complex interdependencies into actionable choices and trade-offs for senior stakeholders. Comfortable operating at the intersection of product, data and engineering, where product logic is tightly coupled with system behaviour. Commercially minded, comfortable supporting ROI, cost-benefit or business-case analysis alongside delivery data. Calm under pressure and comfortable with ambiguity, including operating structures that are still evolving. Support for New Parents: - 52 weeks of paid maternity leave, with 21 weeks being fully paid - 4 weeks of paternity leave, plus the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child is 13 weeks old.
